title: Blueprints (struct)
instructions: A struct is a blueprint that bundles boxes together into one thing.
struct Pet { std::string name; int hunger; }; says every Pet has a name and a hunger number.
Reach a box inside with a dot: rex.name, rex.hunger.
task: Make the program print:  Rex is 3 hungry
hint:
Use the dot to reach each box:

    std::cout << rex.name << " is " << rex.hunger << " hungry\n";
